explanation_steps: $$ AB $$ is a diameter, so $$ \angle AQB = 90^\circ $$: $$ QB^2 = AB^2 - AQ^2 = 64 - 16 = 48 $$.
In right $$ \triangle PQB $$: $$ PB^2 = PQ^2 + QB^2 = 144 + 48 = 192 $$, so $$ PB = 8\sqrt{3} $$.
Power of the point P: $$ PR \cdot PB = PA \cdot PQ = 8 \cdot 12 = 96 $$, so $$ PR = \frac{96}{8\sqrt{3}} = 4\sqrt{3} $$ — option B. (Option C, $$ 8\sqrt{3} $$, is PB.)
